'''Ord Radama''' was an astronomical object<ref name="CL 2016" /> located in the [[Ord Radama system]] in the [[Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Devlikk]] [[species]],<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|image=File:AtlasEmail-2025-09-15.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-09-15}}</ref> including [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[Wan Sandage]].<ref name="CL 2016" />
